taxAdvantage.notes: Cedars-Sinai has been tax-exempt since February 1964. Excess of revenue over expenses of approximately $770M in FY2024 would be subject to 21% federal corporate tax ($162M) if for-profit. California corporate tax rate of 8.84% would apply to state income. Property tax exemption covers major medical campus in West Hollywood/Los Angeles, Marina del Rey hospital, and affiliated facilities in high-value Los Angeles County real estate. Tax-exempt bond interest subsidy applies to $1.03B+ in outstanding Series 2021 debt.

keyRiskFactors: Concentration in high-cost Los Angeles market
California seismic compliance requirements driving capital expenditure
Marina del Rey replacement hospital construction financed with $1.03B in tax-exempt bonds
